text: The Advisor
The Advisor
An old wizard of the Empire who has spent longer giving counsel than most kingdoms have stood. He follows your faction leader from the first day of the campaign, and he will not stay dead for long.

Nobody at court remembers hiring him. He was simply there one morning, leaning on his staff by the war table, already correcting the maps.\\n\\nHe has outlived the generals who ignored him and quietly buried the ones who listened too late. Some say he trained at every College in Altdorf and was thrown out of each in turn. He says only that he has seen how this ends, and would rather it ended differently.
An old, hooded Imperial wizard who fights with staff and sword beside your faction leader.

Master of Arms

Every weapon he has ever held, in every ending, answers him at once. Takes this row's Apex, which locks the other Apexes.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.

Soldiers near him pick up his habits without knowing they have.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.
Army II: Formation
He places men where he once saw them live.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.

A Host of His Own
The men around him fight the way he taught them, whatever he holds.\\n\\nHis army hits harder, holds firmer, stands longer and tires more slowly.
Art I: Stance
The first thing he learned with every weapon he ever held, in every world that ended.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.

He has fought this fight before. His hands remember how it went.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.

Art IV: Ending
How he finished it last time. And the time before that.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hand. Change Loadout lists each weapon's arts.
A Style of His Own
Seven teachers, seven endings, and he took the best of each. What comes out is nobody's but his.\\n\\nHis charges hit like a hammer and his lines hold against cavalry.
Scouting
He knows where they are. He usually knows where they will be.\\n\\nImproves his Scouting hero action, which he always has.
Training
He trains them for the war after this one.\\n\\nUnlocks the Training hero action.
Steal Technology
He has read books that have not been written yet. Theirs are easier.\\n\\nUnlocks the Steal Technology hero action.
Replenish Troops
He finds men to fill the gaps. He knows where they hide.\\n\\nUnlocks the Replenish Troops hero action.
Increase Mobility
He knows the shortcut. He has walked it in three other lives.\\n\\nUnlocks the Increase Mobility hero action.
Scavenge
Nothing on a battlefield is wasted while he is there.\\n\\nUnlocks the Scavenge hero action.
Spread Public Order
He reminds the people what the alternative looks like.\\n\\nUnlocks the Spread Public Order hero action.
Cleanse Corruption
He has seen what the taint becomes. He burns it out early.\\n\\nUnlocks the Cleanse Corruption hero action.
Stimulate Growth
He remembers which years the crops failed, and plants for them.\\n\\nUnlocks the Stimulate Growth hero action.
Increase Trade
He knows which roads will close, and which ships will sink.\\n\\nUnlocks the Increase Trade hero action.
Boost Income
Half the counting-houses in the Empire owe him money from a life they cannot remember.\\n\\nImproves his Boost Income hero action, which he always has.
Power Behind Thrones
Kings come and go. He has advised most of them, in one world or another.\\n\\nThe Civic row's Apex. Takes the place of the other Apexes and the Polymath.
Practised Aim
He has loosed arrows at the end of every kind of world. The hand knows where to go.\\n\\nStronger missile damage, faster reloads.
Shell of Light
A thin shimmer of the Winds holds in front of him.\\n\\nHe gains barrier health.
Light Along the Line
He has learned to stretch the shimmer thin, across every rank that stands with him.\\n\\nEvery unit in his army gains barrier health.
Mended Shell
A broken shell is a lesson. He has learned to stitch it faster.\\n\\nBarriers return sooner and faster, for him and for his army.
Blade of the Winds
At the end of one world the Winds themselves held his sword arm. He remembers the grip.\\n\\nHe fights as a decent magical duellist, and the army he marches with fights harder.
Deep Quiver
The last arrow is always the one he saved for himself. He stopped saving it.\\n\\nMore ammunition.
The Long Breath
He has fought for days at the end of the world. One afternoon does not tire him.\\n\\nHe and his army tire more slowly in battle.
Long Sight
A target seen sooner is a target already lost.\\n\\nLonger missile range.
Flesh Remembers
His body has healed from worse, many times. It still knows how.\\n\\nHealing can restore more of his health and his army's in battle.
Weight of the Charge
He learned to charge from a knight who rode into the last sunset of a dying world.\\n\\nHe runs faster, hits harder on the charge and lands heavier.
Piercing Shot
Aim for the buckle. The buckle is where armour ends.\\n\\nMissile attacks pierce armour better.
Warden of the Shell

Where he stands, broken shells knit again. The men near him feel it before they understand it.\\n\\nUnlocks the Paragon of Change ability, which restores the barrier of nearby combatants, and deepens the Winds reserve.
Ironbound Sleeves
Leather, steel, and a lesson from a swordsman who did not live to see the sequel.\\n\\nStronger melee attack.
Steel in the Weave
Every cut carries a little of the spell that guided it.\\n\\nHarder-hitting melee blows.
Storm of Needles
One shot, then a hundred, then the sky goes dark with them.\\n\\nHis missile attacks hit harder and farther, and the army he marches with shoots faster.
Unbroken
He has been the last man standing. It taught him how to be the first one back up.\\n\\nHe is harder to break and harder to kill, and the army he marches with holds its ground behind a stronger shell.
Veteran's Hide
Scar over scar over scar. Little finds soft skin to bite.\\n\\nMore armour.
Duelling Wards
A flick of the wrist and the blade glances aside. He has practised it on worse than swords.\\n\\nA ward save.
Spread Chaos Corruption
He has watched Chaos corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.\\n\\nUnlocks the Spread Chaos Corruption hero action, and each level spreads it harder.

Every kind of corruption he has learned spreads far faster.\\n\\nNeeds 3 points in this row.

The Banner Remembered

A banner remembered is a banner that does not fall. Every army he has ever stood with fights harder for it.\\n\\nEvery army in the faction costs less to keep, recovers faster and holds firmer, and his own army costs less again.
Forager's Eye
Where others see scrub, he sees supper.\\n\\nMore loot after every battle.
A Hand in Every Pocket

Every door in the world has a friend on the inside, and he has met all of them.\\n\\nAll the faction's heroes act with more success, every army returns richer from battle, research speeds up, and his own army ambushes and moves better.
The Lamp in the Window

Wherever he rests, someone leaves a light on. He has never asked them to.\\n\\nEvery province of the faction is calmer and richer, all armies learn faster and hold firmer, and his own army learns fastest of all. Lords and heroes join the faction with even more ranks.
Pathfinder
He has walked this road in four endings. It never got shorter by itself.\\n\\nHis army marches farther each turn.
Students in Every Court
Half the captains of the world once sat at his table and listened.\\n\\nLords and heroes join the faction with more ranks.
Arcane Ward
A thin shimmer, taught to him by a mage whose name no one else recalls.\\n\\nA ward save.
Archmage

Every lore he ever learned, in every world, answers him now.\\n\\nEach turn his army gains one random cataclysm spell, a memory of how some world ended.\\n\\nThe magic rows' Apex. Takes the place of the other Apexes and the Polymath.
Spell and Steel
He casts with one hand and cuts with the other, and has never found the two work apart.\\n\\nStronger blows and spells, whatever he carries.
Weave Beyond Sight
There is a pattern behind the pattern. He has seen it from the far side.\\n\\nMuch stronger spells, fewer miscasts, and he sees farther.
Steady Cadence
The same words, the same breath, every time. The Winds learn to expect it.\\n\\nStronger spells.
Open Channel
The Winds find him now. They have learned where he stands.\\n\\nMore Winds of Magic each turn for his army.
Conduit Unbound
He stopped asking the Winds for power. Now he simply lets them through.\\n\\nOvercast spells recharge much sooner and hit harder.
Spellweaver's Focus
Every ending, the first thing he learned was to hold one thought steady while the world shook.\\n\\nMore spell intensity.
The Last Word

He no longer waits for the Winds to cool. He cuts the pause out of every spell.\\n\\nSpells of every lore cost less and recharge much sooner, and he casts with greater mastery. Needs 3 points in this group.
Overcast Discipline
Anyone can pour more power in. He knows when to stop.\\n\\nOvercast spells recharge sooner.
Quiet Mind
The Winds come easier to a mind with no fear left in it.\\n\\nSpells recharge sooner.
Quick Recitation
The words come faster each time. He has said them in every tongue that ever ended.\\n\\nSpells recharge sooner.
Deep Reserves
He has learned to hold more of the Winds than a body should.\\n\\nMore Winds of Magic for his army in every battle.
Hex of Misfire
He knows exactly how a spell goes wrong, because he has watched it go wrong.\\n\\nEnemy spellcasters near his army miscast more often, and their spells cost more.
Second Wind
Just when the pool runs dry, he finds another cup behind it.\\n\\nA deeper Winds of Magic pool.
Sharper Weave
And then to pull it tight, to a point.\\n\\nStronger spells, fewer miscasts.
Standing Conduit
The Winds do not rush through him anymore. They wait in him, patient, like water in a cistern.\\n\\nUnlocks the Arcane Conduit ability. Level 2 replaces it with Greater Arcane Conduit.
Steady Hands
He miscast once, at the worst possible moment, and the world ended a little early.\\n\\nFewer miscasts, stronger spells.
Warded Mind
He has been unmade by sorcery before. He remembers the shape of the hole.\\n\\nMagic resistance.
The Well Remembers
He has drunk from this well in lives that never were. The well recalls him kindly.\\n\\nMore Winds of Magic each turn, and spells that recharge sooner.
What Comes
He has already seen how the next casting will end.\\n\\nHe keeps the passive powers of a third of the lores, and their spells cost less.\\nLevel 2 opens at rank 25, level 3 at rank 30.
What Is Held
He does not reach for the old lores. They are simply there, held.\\n\\nHe keeps the passive powers of a third of the lores, and their spells cost less.\\nLevel 2 opens at rank 25, level 3 at rank 30.
What Was Learned
Every lore he ever studied left a habit behind.\\n\\nHe keeps the passive powers of a third of the lores, and their spells cost less.\\nLevel 2 opens at rank 25, level 3 at rank 30.
Wider Weave
He learned to let the thread spread before it settles.\\n\\nStronger spells.
Assassinate
He knows which of them will matter later. He settles it now.\\n\\nUnlocks the Assassinate hero action.
Wound
Not a killing blow. A reminder.\\n\\nUnlocks the Wound hero action.
Assassinate Lord

Generals die too. He has watched it happen in every ending.\\n\\nUnlocks the Assassinate Lord hero action. It has a slim 5 percent base chance to kill, raised by his hero success chance. A failed attempt costs him nothing but the try.
Damage Walls
Every wall falls eventually. He only hurries it along.\\n\\nUnlocks the Damage Walls hero action.
Assault Garrison
He walks in through the gate they forgot to watch.\\n\\nUnlocks the Assault Garrison hero action.
Damage Building
A fire in the right storehouse ends a siege early.\\n\\nUnlocks the Damage Building hero action.
Block Army
A cut rope, a spooked horse, a missing quartermaster.\\n\\nUnlocks the Block Army hero action.
Hinder Replenishment
Their wounded do not come back to the line.\\n\\nUnlocks the Hinder Replenishment hero action.
Assault Units
The whole camp, the same night.\\n\\nUnlocks the Assault Units hero action.
The Last Sword
At the end of one world he was the last one standing. He intends to be again.\\n\\nThe Martial row's Apex. Takes the place of the other Apexes and the Polymath.
Calm Voice
Men stand firm around someone who is not afraid. He stopped being afraid a long time ago.
The Ending of Drowning

The sea came in over the walls. He held a shield above his head for a long time.\\n\\nHis blows carry Dampening, Horrible and Charming at once.\\n\\nHe turns missiles aside and his army holds firm. Its charges bog down in the mud.
The Ending of Fire

The sky burned for nine days and he watched it from the last tower. His blade remembers the heat.\\n\\nHis blows carry Flaming, Inflammable and Warpflame at once.\\n\\nHe hits harder and charges harder. The memory leaves him thin-skinned.
The Ending of Hunger

The granaries were empty before the first battle. He remembers what was worth taking.\\n\\nHis blows carry Slow Death, Sundering and Anraheir's Curse at once.\\n\\nHis army fights like starving men, hard and without mercy. Its quivers run thin.
The Ending of Plague

The cities emptied quietly. He learned what a slow death tastes like.\\n\\nHis blows carry Poison, Contaminated and Eroding Poison at once.\\n\\nHis blows bite through armour and cut down infantry. The fever makes his spells falter.
The Ending of Silence

Nobody screamed. The army simply stopped arriving. He keeps his own march quiet now.\\n\\nHis blows carry Discouraging, Rattling and Disrupting at once.\\n\\nHe is harder to hit and deadly against large foes. The quiet leaves his wards thin.
Every Mistake Already Made
There is no error left for him to make. He made them all in other lives.
The Long Patience

He has all the time in the world. He has had it before.\\n\\nA hundred small levels for points nothing else wants: each adds 1 percent spell intensity, 1 percent weapon strength and 1 percent missile strength.
Old Lessons
Everything he teaches, he learned the hard way. Several times.
Everything, Again

He has been a swordsman, a sorcerer, a spy and a steward, in one ending or another. This time he will be all of them.\\n\\nThe Polymath. It grows with each discipline (Arts, Memory, Magic, Hero work) in which he has 3 skills. Takes the place of every Apex.
Seen the End
He has watched this army walk into this ambush before. Not this time.
The Weight of Years
He has died before. He did not care for it, and he takes more killing now.
Spellguard
He parries with the staff and lets the wards take the rest.
Bolt and Blade
A bolt to open the guard, a cut to close it.
Winds in the Steel
The sword carries what the staff gathers.
Unbinding
Blows that should land slide off a man who knows where they were going.
Hedge Wards
Small charms on every banner pole.
Patient Lines
He teaches them to wait for the spell to land.
Calm in the Storm
Magic does not frighten men who have seen him use it.
Channelled Staff
The staff drinks the Winds and gives them back to him.
Woven Wards
He threads a ward through every rank before the first blow.
Shield Wall
He stands where the blows land thickest and lets them come.
Turn the Arrow
He has watched too many men die to arrows to let it happen to him.
Steady Hand
A knight's shield, a scholar's patience.
Bulwark
He does not move, and nothing moves him.
Hold the Line
Men stand firm next to a man who will not step back.
Shields Up
He calls the volley before the archers loose.
Unbroken
This line held once, at the end of the world. It will hold now.
Shield of Faith
Not his god's faith. His own, that this time will be different.
Shield Wall
Every shield overlaps the next, the way he showed them.
Overhand
A blow from above, with all of him behind it.
Momentum
Once the blade is moving, nothing in front of it matters.
Cleaving Arc
One swing, three men. He has done the sums.
Headsman
Big things die the same way small ones do.
Bloody Drill
He makes them practise until they stop flinching.
Charge Them
He goes first. They follow.
Butcher's Bill
He knows what this battle will cost and pays it early.
Killing Blow
The blow that ended a king, in a world nobody else remembers.
Through the Plate
He teaches them where the armour is thinnest.
Steady Draw
He breathes out, and the arrow goes where he looked.
Long Eye
He sees the shot before he takes it.
Full Quiver
He never runs out. He planned for this.
Quick Hands
Draw, loose, draw, loose, faster than thought.
Huntsmen
He shows the archers where to aim.
Marked Ground
Every stone and stake is a range marker to him.
From the Trees
He knows where the enemy will walk, because he has watched them walk there before.
Hail of Doom
One arrow that splits into a storm.
Quick Hands
Nock, draw, loose. He counts it out until they no longer need him to.
